description: Messaging layer via aweb: per-instance team identities + native aw mail/chat skills + cross-machine team roster.

requires.why: identity minting at spawn, self-delete at retire, and all agent messaging
the aweb channel extension for pi sessions — real-time mail/chat awakenings; without it a pi instance can send with `aw` but is never woken by incoming messages
requires.install: https://aweb.ai/docs (installed into pi with `pi install npm:@awebai/pi`)

requires.why: the aweb channel plugin for Claude Code sessions — real-time mail/chat awakenings; without it a Claude instance can send with `aw` but is never woken by incoming messages
requires.install: https://aweb.ai/docs (installs the awebai marketplace and the aweb-channel plugin into Claude Code)

requires.why: with session delivery the ambient aweb extension must honour AWEB_DELIVERY=session (0.3.10 and later); an older one would open a second event stream beside the wake broker

delivery.description: channel: the native aweb channel packages wake the instance (default). session: delivery is external (AWEB_DELIVERY=session), no channel flag; the host wake broker registers the instance once it exists.
